name: Spy Kids: Armageddon | Hyskor Run
desc:
UPDATE: NEW UGC!! The OSS Boss Shades: how to tell everyone you're a boss without telling them you're a boss.  These shades are only worn by master OSS agents.  NEW 2ND MAP ADDED! New ways to earn bytes and XP on the Kings Platform!! 

Like 👍  favorite 🤩 and join the group to get all the Super Spy updates!
The Armageddon code has been launched and it’s now up to you to beat HYSKOR and save the world. Join the OSS now! Your mission awaits, agent!

🕵🏻 Become an OSS Spy in the official Spy Kids: Armageddon game

🤸🏽‍♀️ Train in the Sim Gym to build your spy skills

🤜👊🤛 Battle skeletons, avoid traps and dodge the dreaded Heck Knight to reach the King’s Platform

⚙️ Discover and unlock unique spy gadgets that give you an edge over your spy competition

🏃🏽‍♀️🧗🏻‍♂️🏃🏻‍♀️ Compete with other spies in timed and survival modes to be crowned the King of the Platform!
